record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: Does there exist a non-rational irreducible component of Hilb_d(A^n)?

evidence.quote: Problem XX ([95, 4]). Does there exist a non-rational component of Hilbd(A^n)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For positive integers $d$ and $n$, let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^n)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional closed subschemes of length $d$ in affine $n$-space $\mathbb{A}^n$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. An irreducible component $Z$ of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^n)$ (taken with its reduced scheme structure) is said to be rational if it is birational to a projective space (equivalently, its function field is purely transcendental over the base field).

Question: Do there exist integers $d \geq 1$ and $n \geq 1$ such that $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^n)$ has an irreducible component which is not rational?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work by Farkas, Jelisiejew, and others ("Irrational components of the Hilbert scheme of points") establishes the existence of non-rational, indeed not rationally connected, irreducible components of Hilb_d(A^n) for n sufficiently large (n ≥ 12), by relating such components to moduli of curves M_g, which is of general type for g ≥ 22. This affirmatively answers the existence question, although the minimal n for which irrational components occur remains of independent interest.

status_evidence.title: Irrational components of the Hilbert scheme of points
status_evidence.snippet: For each n ≥ 12, there exist irreducible components of Hilb(A^n) that are not rational, and indeed not rationally connected.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of non-rational (even non-rationally-connected) components of Hilb_d(A^n) is established for n ≥ 12.

status_evidence.title: Components of Hilbert schemes (AIM problem list)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem list on components of Hilbert schemes including questions about rationality of components.
status_evidence.claim: The rationality of components of Hilbert schemes of points has been a tracked open problem.
